name: 60428 · Markham, IL
findings: ZIP 60428 (Markham) has 56 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60428 (Markham) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60428 (Markham) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
